description: This file contains integration tests for the CatalogItem API endpoint, verifying authorization behavior and response content when creating catalog items.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpointTest
classes.description: Contains test methods for the catalog item creation API endpoint, testing authorization and response validation.

methods.name: ReturnsNotAuthorizedGivenNormalUserToken
methods.description: Verifies that a normal user token receives a Forbidden response when creating a catalog item.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidNewItemAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Verifies that an admin token successfully creates a catalog item and response matches expected data.

methods.name: GetValidNewItemJson
methods.description: Constructs and returns a StringContent object containing a serialized valid new catalog item request.
